beats.text: Nearly half of adults in East Timor use tobacco. In Nigeria, the share is just 3.1%.
East Timor hits 48.8%. That is 16 times the tobacco use found in Nigeria.
Nigeria sits at 3.1%. The lowest share across all 163 countries and territories on the map.
Lebanon climbs to 46.9% and Myanmar is 43.4%. High numbers span the globe.
The USA is 15.8%, China is 22.8%, and India is 22.6%.
